text_block_list.text:
Today, I came out with Admire Vega
to buy ingredients for sandwiches.

What she is making is apparently tomorrow's lunch.
However, it's not for Admire Vega herself to eat. The reason being—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha!
I appear for the fourth time!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Opera O-chan!
Are you doing that again today...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's the 5th time. Not the 4th.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'll appear again and again, as many times as it takes, Ayabe-san!
That's right—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Not until you participate in the 'Overlord Generation's Utterly Delightful Lunch Exchange'!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Opera O is so cute~
Ayabe-san, girls in your generation really
are super attached to you, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if they'll come tomorrow too?
They're seriously here every day, it's becoming something I look forward to at lunch!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... of course it's entirely up to you,
but Doto-chan and I would be so, so happy
if you could come, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"How about just once?
It'll be so much fun to swap lunches with everyone!"
...And just like that, it seemed to have broken.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A homemade lunch exchange party...?
It's not like I'm good at cooking in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sandwiches are the only thing
I can make decently...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Let me hear your thoughts on the ingredients, too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Since the person I'm exchanging with will be eating it rather than me……
it wouldn't be right to just make it based on my own tastes.
Smiling warmly at Admire Vega's earnest effort to see things through to the end, I take a look around the area.

Standard ingredients would be easy to gather quickly.
The difficulty of preparation wouldn't be too high either.
On the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up!!
We've got a whole lineup of rare items and delicacies you won't find anywhere else~!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Use this right, and oh my, like magic!
Your everyday home cooking will level up dramatically in flavor~!
choice_data_list: (I guess they sell some unusual stuff here too.)
(They sell some unusual stuff here too, huh.)

text_block_list.text:
If used well, it might make for a high-tier sandwich.
That said, many of these seem difficult to handle, so it looks pretty risky.
Now then, what should we do?

Even if it was ordinary, her peers
would surely appreciate it.
With that in mind, I recommended safe, standard ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What's this, what's this?
I saw some folks in uniform and wondered who it was...
Turns out it's Ayabe and the gang!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Tamamo-san... Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!
So, are the two of you out shopping together or something today?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, sandwiches!
You make such fancy stuff, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I saw Creek making star-shaped sandwiches the other day, you know?
Do you ever make stuff like that too, Ayabe?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, as for me...
I do have the mold, if that's all you need...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, I guess ya don't see that too often.
Still, that kinda thing is pretty darn cute, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I figured making some for the little ones
would make 'em really happy too."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I could fill my belly just on the scrap pieces left over after cutting out the molds! Hahaha!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...The younger kids will probably start saying
they want to eat the crusts too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I understand how you feel, but...

Touched by Tamamo Cross's caring feelings for her siblings,
Admire Vega's expression softened slightly...

Let's make a daring suggestion!
With that thought, I recommended a meat-centric diet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Ayabe and company!
What's up, are you guys on the hunt for the ultimate meat too?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's not that extreme, but...
choice_data_list: Hishi Amazon went off to search for 'the ultimate meat'...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Just a little something
for Brian's boxed lunch."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If every single meal is 'Eat your hated veggies!,
it'll totally kill your drive, right?
You gotta have a treat every now and then!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm thinking of cooking up the ultimate
meat dish to blow that carnivore away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a one-on-one duel with her through bento!
On the name of Big Sis Hishiama, I won't lose!
choice_data_list: It's nice to make something while putting so much thought into the other person.
Making something while keeping the other person in mind so much is really sweet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, if you're giving something, that's the absolute basic first step!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thank you. That was... somewhat helpful.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Haha, not quite sure what you mean, but good for you!

Did Admire Vega decide to make it
with the recipient in mind as well?
And so, the result of the lunch exchange was...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
A-Ayabe-san, this is...!!
Um, this... is delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, it's delicious...!
It's really... really amazing, so delicious...!
Wah, um... it's so delicious...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Your vocabulary is something else.
Aren't you supposed to be an honor student...?"
...Looks like it was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...He finished all of it.
He said it was 'delicious'... well, sort of."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your cooperation.
It seemed to have succeeded without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... declined to participate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It didn't turn out good enough to serve to anyone, after all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. It's not your fault.
In the end, I was the one who decided.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's merely... a lack of skill...
It seems to have ended in a disappointing result...

Let's make a daring suggestion!
With that thought, I recommended a fish-centric diet.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! I thought I recognized that celestial look!
If it isn't Adve-sanâI mean, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hello. ...Well, see you.

Though she properly returned the greeting,
Admire Vega attempted to walk away with astonishing coolness!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa-whoa-whoa!! Too fast!!
At least listen to two more lines of mine first~!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I only came to get my shopping done.
I don't have time to play around with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean, talkin' like Golshi-chan just goofs off
24/7, 365 days a year, for 4.6 billion years straight!
...Well, I do, but still!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If that's what you're saying, then our conversation is over.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, wait, wait, wait! At least
tell me how comet tails are classified~~~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: An ion tail made of gas, and a dust tail made of dust. ...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, this is the last one! Seriously the very last one, so please tell me which constellation gave its name to the Mira-type pulsating variable stars~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Mira of Cetus. ...Let us end this here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey hey hey, what's that group of asteroids that shares nearly the same orbital path as Jupiter—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trojan asteroids. ...Give me a break already!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, I shouldn't be talking since I did it three times myself,
but you're seriously way too dutiful."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh...
...Perhaps as a gesture of thanks, Gold Ship—who was oddly knowledgeable about seafood—made a major contribution to selecting the ingredients.
And so, the result of the lunch exchange was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what sublime flavor! What nourishment!
A supreme saaaandwiiich to thoroughly satisfy the Overlord's appetite~~~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wagner, Rossini, Verdi,
Mozart too! One bite, and they'd all
start composing songs in praise of this!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Never mind that, just eat quietly.
...Looks like it was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...He finished all of it.
He said it was 'delicious'... well, sort of."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your cooperation.
It seemed to have succeeded without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... declined to participate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It didn't turn out good enough to serve to anyone, after all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. It's not your fault.
In the end, I was the one who decided.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's merely... a lack of skill...
It seems to have ended in a disappointing result...

Let's make a daring suggestion!
With that thought, I recommended a vegetable-centric diet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, Taishin-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um, hello...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Um, are you out shopping too, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...You too, Taishin-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hm, well... there's this nag going on and on
about nutrients absorbed from food or whatever—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, sorry, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what about you...?
Don't tell me, the person who came to our class today was—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...No, maybe this is fine too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, over that way,
there were a lot of ingredients that seemed pretty easy to work with.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Is that so? ...Thank you.

Though she doesn't go out of her way to put it into words,
her feelings toward her comrades are somewhat similar—I've met a girl like that as well.
And so, the result of the lunch exchange was...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-It's so, so delicioussss~!
Hawawa, as expected of Ayabe-san...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Not a single crumb...! I won't drop even one, absolutely not!
I will treasure and savor every last bit...!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You don't need to be so on guard.
...Looks like it was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...He finished all of it.
He said it was 'delicious'... well, sort of."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your cooperation.
It seemed to have succeeded without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... declined to participate.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It didn't turn out good enough to serve to anyone, after all...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. It's not your fault.
In the end, I was the one who decided.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's merely... a lack of skill...
It seems to have ended in a disappointing result...
